profile.name: Jordan Rivers
profile.tagline: Designing interactive storytelling systems that travel across every platform.
profile.summary: Curious, human-centered technologist crafting narrative-driven products for web, conversational AI, and live events.
focus: Designing adaptive story flows for Gemini
Hosting an open archive for public readers
Pairing writers with AI copilots that keep their voice intact
prompts: How did today's experiment change the way you tell this story?
What would a first-time visitor remember from this chapter?
Which collaborator helped illuminate the theme today?
Where could a small prototype relieve friction for readers?

timeline.title: First interactive memoir prototype
timeline.description: Sketched a branching narrative using index cards and short audio clips. Learned how nonlinear storytelling opens empathy.

timeline.title: Open-sourced interactive timeline
timeline.description: Released a toolkit for crafting personal history websites. Collaborated with volunteers to translate it into five languages.

timeline.title: Railway deployment pipeline
timeline.description: Built a pipeline for deploying stories to Railway with linting, visual diffs, and performance budgets.

timeline.title: Conversational archive pilot
timeline.description: Taught the story to answer questions in plain language, with receipts from the timeline for trust.

timeline.title: Immersive reading room
timeline.description: Mixed spatial audio and tactile cues to help visitors feel each chapter, both online and at live events.

achievements.title: Public archive relaunch
achievements.description: Rebuilt the autobiography for fast static hosting and resilient offline access.
details: Implemented prefetching and responsive images for 40% faster loads
Published Railway-ready deployment manifest for frictionless shipping
Added transparent versioning so collaborators can follow along

achievements.title: Conversation-ready narrative
achievements.description: Designed prompts, memory constraints, and safety rails for chat-based storytelling.
details: Introduced retrieval layers that keep answers grounded with citations
Built tone-aware responses to mirror the author's voice
Captured reader feedback loops to improve each release

achievements.title: Accessibility and inclusion upgrade
achievements.description: Rolled out tactile-friendly controls, prefers-reduced-motion support, and high-contrast palettes.
details: Documented rituals for manual and automated accessibility checks
Ensured every narrative card stays legible across light and dark themes
Partnered with readers to test screen reader flows end-to-end
